Data Intro

RAVDESS

  • Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song (RAVDESS)

1440 files in total. The RAVDESS contains 24 professional actors(neutral North American accent). Speech emotions include calm, happy, sad, angry, fearful, surprise, and disgust expressions. Each expression is produced at two levels of emotional intensity (normal, strong), with an additional neutral expression.

The following datasets are processed with a similar pipeline.

RAVDESS = './data/RAVDESS/'
ravdess_directory_list = os.listdir(RAVDESS)
type = []
actor_list = []
path_list = []
gender_list = []
emotion_list = []

code_to_emotion = {
    '03' : 'happy',
    '01' : 'neutral',
    '04' : 'sad',
    '05' : 'angry',
    '06' : 'fear',
    '07' : 'disgust',
}

# Building standard dataframe
for directory in ravdess_directory_list:
    actor_files = os.listdir(os.path.join(RAVDESS, directory))
    for audio_file in actor_files: 
        part = audio_file.split('.')[0]
        code = part.split('-')[2]
        if code in code_to_emotion:
            gender_code = int(part.split('-')[6])
            type.append('RAVDESS')  # Dataset name
            actor_list.append(directory)  # Actor
            path_list.append(f"{RAVDESS}{directory}/{audio_file}")  # File path
            gender_list.append('female' if gender_code & 1 == 0 else 'male')  # Gender
            emotion_list.append(code_to_emotion[code])  # Emotion
        
            
ravdess = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame(type, columns=['type']),
    pd.DataFrame(actor_list, columns=['actor']),
    pd.DataFrame(path_list, columns=['path']),
    pd.DataFrame(gender_list, columns=['sex']),
    pd.DataFrame(emotion_list, columns=['emotion'])
], axis=1)

Crema-D

  • Crowd Sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset (CREMA-D)

A data set of 7442 original clips from 91 actors. Actors spoke from a selection of 12 sentences. The sentences were presented using one of six different emotions (Anger, Disgust, Fear, Happy, Neutral, and Sad) and four different emotion levels (Low, Medium, High, and Unspecified).

# All female actor id
female_id_set = {
    '1002','1003','1004','1006','1007','1008','1009','1010','1012','1013',
    '1018','1020','1021','1024','1025','1028','1029','1030','1037','1043',
    '1046','1047','1049','1052','1053','1054','1055','1056','1058','1060',
    '1061','1063','1072','1073','1074','1075','1076','1078','1079','1082',
    '1084','1089','1091'
}
EMOTION_MAP = {
    'ANG': 0,
    'DIS': 1,
    'FEA': 2,
    'HAP': 3,
    'NEU': 4,
    'SAD': 5
}

audio_dir = "./data/AudioWAV/"

files = [f for f in os.listdir(audio_dir) if f.endswith(".wav")]
data = []

for f in files:
    parts = f.split("_")
    actor_id = parts[0]
    emotion = parts[2]
    type = 'Crema-D'  # Dataset name

    # Mark gender
    if actor_id not in female_id_set:
        sex = 'male'
    else:
        sex = 'female'
    
    if emotion not in EMOTION_MAP:
        continue
    
    emotion_label = EMOTION_MAP[emotion]
    
    data.append({
        "type": type,
        "file": os.path.join(audio_dir, f),
        "actor": actor_id,
        "sex": sex,
        "emotion": emotion,
        "label": emotion_label
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
print(df.head())
print(df["label"].value_counts())

# Downsample Crema-D to balance training data

target_per_class = {
    0: 0,  # angry
    1: 900,  # disgust
    2: 700,  # fear
    3: 450,  # happy
    4: 0,  # neutral
    5: 300   # sad
}

balanced_data = []

for label in sorted(df["label"].unique()):
    
    df_label = df[df["label"] == label]
    
    target_total = target_per_class[label]
    target_gender = target_total // 5
    
    df_male = df_label[df_label["sex"] == "male"]
    df_female = df_label[df_label["sex"] == "female"]
    
    if len(df_male) < target_gender or len(df_female) < target_gender:
        print(f"Warning: Not enough samples for label {label}")
        continue
    
    # Also balance male and female
    df_male_sampled = df_male.sample(n=target_gender*3, random_state=42)
    df_female_sampled = df_female.sample(n=target_gender*2, random_state=42)
    
    balanced_data.append(df_male_sampled)
    balanced_data.append(df_female_sampled)

df = pd.concat(balanced_data).reset_index(drop=True)

# Check
print("\nAfter balancing:")
print(df.head())
print(df["label"].value_counts())
print(df["sex"].value_counts())

Tess

2800 audio files in total. A set of 200 target words was spoken in the carrier phrase “Say the word …’ by two actresses. Recordings were made of the set portraying each of seven emotions (anger, disgust, fear, happiness, pleasant surprise, sadness, and neutral).

TESS = './data/TESS/'
tess_dir_list = os.listdir(TESS)
type = []
actor_list = []
path_list = []
gender_list = []
emotion_list = [] 

code_to_emotion = {
    'happy'   : 'happy',
    'neutral' : 'neutral',
    'sad'     : 'sad',
    'Sad'     : 'sad',
    'angry'   : 'angry',
    'fear'    : 'fear',
    'disgust' : 'disgust',
}

# Building standard dataframe
for directory in tess_dir_list:
    audio_files = os.listdir(os.path.join(TESS, directory))
    for audio_file in audio_files:
        part = audio_file.split('.')[0]
        actor = directory.split('_')[0]
        code = part.split('_')[2]
        if code in code_to_emotion:
            type.append('TESS')
            actor_list.append(actor)
            path_list.append(f"{TESS}{directory}/{audio_file}") 
            gender_list.append('female') # female only dataset
            emotion_list.append(code_to_emotion[code])
            
tess = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame(type, columns=['type']),
    pd.DataFrame(actor_list, columns=['actor']),
    pd.DataFrame(path_list, columns=['path']),
    pd.DataFrame(gender_list, columns=['sex']),
    pd.DataFrame(emotion_list, columns=['emotion'])
], axis=1)

tess.head()
type actor path sex emotion
0 TESS OAF ./data/TESS/OAF_angry/OAF_back_angry.wav female angry
1 TESS OAF ./data/TESS/OAF_angry/OAF_bar_angry.wav female angry
2 TESS OAF ./data/TESS/OAF_angry/OAF_base_angry.wav female angry
3 TESS OAF ./data/TESS/OAF_angry/OAF_bath_angry.wav female angry
4 TESS OAF ./data/TESS/OAF_angry/OAF_bean_angry.wav female angry 
# Map emotion names to numeric labels
TESS_EMOTION_MAP = {
    'angry': 0,
    'disgust': 1,
    'fear': 2,
    'happy': 3,
    'neutral': 4,
    'sad': 5
}

tess = tess[tess["emotion"].isin(TESS_EMOTION_MAP.keys())]

tess["label"] = tess["emotion"].map(TESS_EMOTION_MAP)

# Rename columns
tess = tess.rename(columns={"path": "file"})

# Balanced sampling: emotion + actor
samples_per_emotion = 1200 // len(TESS_EMOTION_MAP)
actors = tess["actor"].unique()
num_actors = len(actors)

samples_per_actor = samples_per_emotion // num_actors

balanced_groups = []

for (emotion, actor), group in tess.groupby(["emotion", "actor"]):
    
    # in case some groups are smaller
    n = min(len(group), samples_per_actor)
    
    balanced_groups.append(
        group.sample(n=n, random_state=42)
    )

tess = pd.concat(balanced_groups).reset_index(drop=True)

print(tess.head())
print(tess["label"].value_counts())
print(tess["sex"].value_counts())

EmoDB

A German emotional dataset. Ten professional speakers participated in data recording, and the database contains a total of 535 utterances.

EMODB = './data/EmoDB/'

    'T' : 'sad', 
    'N' : 'neutral'
}

ShEMO

A Persian emotional dataset. The database includes 3000 semi-natural utterances, covering speech samples of 87 native-Persian speakers for five basic emotions, including anger, fear, happiness, sadness, and surprise, as well as a neutral state

ShEMO = './data/ShEMO/'
ShEMO_directory_list = os.listdir(ShEMO)
type = []
actor_list = []
path_list = []
gender_list = []
emotion_list = []

code_to_emotion = {
    'H' : 'happy',
    'N' : 'neutral',
    'S' : 'sad',
    'A' : 'angry',
    'F' : 'fear'
}

# Building standard dataframe
for audio_file in ShEMO_directory_list:
    sex = audio_file[0]
    actor = audio_file[0:3]
    code = audio_file[3]
    if code in code_to_emotion:
        type.append('ShEMO')
        actor_list.append(actor)
        path_list.append(f"{ShEMO}{audio_file}")
        gender_list.append('male' if sex == 'M' else 'female')
        emotion_list.append(code_to_emotion[code])
        
ShEMO = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame(type, columns=['type']),
    pd.DataFrame(actor_list, columns=['actor']),
    pd.DataFrame(path_list, columns=['path']),
    pd.DataFrame(gender_list, columns=['sex']),
    pd.DataFrame(emotion_list, columns=['emotion'])
], axis=1)

    pd.DataFrame(path_list, columns=['path']),

], axis=1)

RAVDESS Song

  • Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song (RAVDESS)

Song version of RAVDESS

RAVDESS_song = './data/RAV_song/'
RAVDESS_song_directory_list = os.listdir(RAVDESS_song)
type = []
actor_list = []
path_list = []
gender_list = []
emotion_list = []

code_to_emotion = {
    '03' : 'happy',
    '01' : 'neutral',
    '04' : 'sad',
    '05' : 'angry',
    '06' : 'fear',
    '07' : 'disgust',
}

# Building standard dataframe
for directory in RAVDESS_song_directory_list:
    actor_files = os.listdir(os.path.join(RAVDESS_song, directory))
    for audio_file in actor_files: 
        part = audio_file.split('.')[0]
        code = part.split('-')[2]
        if code in code_to_emotion:
            gender_code = int(part.split('-')[6])
            type.append('RAV_song')
            actor_list.append(directory)
            path_list.append(f"{RAVDESS_song}{directory}/{audio_file}")
            gender_list.append('female' if gender_code & 1 == 0 else 'male')
            emotion_list.append(code_to_emotion[code])
        
            
RAVDESS_song = pd.concat([
    pd.DataFrame(type, columns=['type']),
    pd.DataFrame(actor_list, columns=['actor']),
    pd.DataFrame(path_list, columns=['path']),
    pd.DataFrame(gender_list, columns=['sex']),
    pd.DataFrame(emotion_list, columns=['emotion'])
], axis=1)

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

def split_df(df):
    train, temp = train_test_split(
        df,
        test_size=0.3,
        stratify=df["label"],
        random_state=42
    )
    
    val, test = train_test_split(
        temp,
        test_size=0.5,
        stratify=temp["label"],
        random_state=42
    )
    
    return train, val, test

Data Preprocessing

Preprocess all audio samples to fixed-duration mel-spectrograms.

from tqdm import tqdm
from scipy import interpolate

def precompute_mel(df, save_dir="./mel_cache", sr=22050, duration=8, n_mels=128):
    os.makedirs(save_dir, exist_ok=True)
    target_len = sr * duration

    for file_path in tqdm(df["file"]):
        # Dataset-friendly filename
        filename = file_path.replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_").replace(".wav", ".npy")
        save_path = os.path.join(save_dir, filename)

        if os.path.exists(save_path):
            continue

        try:
            y, _ = librosa.load(file_path, sr=sr)
            y, _ = librosa.effects.trim(y, top_db=15)  # Treat low db as silence

            # pad / cut to fixed length
            if len(y) > target_len:
                y = y[:target_len]
            else:
                y = np.pad(y, (0, target_len - len(y)))

            # Get mel spectrogram
            mel = librosa.feature.melspectrogram(
                y=y,
                sr=sr,
                n_mels=n_mels,
                hop_length=512,
                n_fft=1024
            )

            mel_db = librosa.power_to_db(mel, ref=np.max)  # power spectrogram

            # Normalize
            mel_db = (mel_db - np.mean(mel_db)) / (np.std(mel_db) + 1e-6)

            np.save(save_path, mel_db)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error processing {file_path}: {e}")

def spec_augment(mel, freq_mask_param=15, time_mask_param=30):
    """
    Data Augmentation
    """

    mel = mel.clone()

    _, F, T = mel.shape

    # Frequency masking
    f = random.randint(0, freq_mask_param)
    f0 = random.randint(0, max(0, F - f))
    mel[:, f0:f0+f, :] = 0

    # Time masking
    t = random.randint(0, time_mask_param)
    t0 = random.randint(0, max(0, T - t))
    mel[:, :, t0:t0+t] = 0

    return mel
class RetrieveDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, dataframe, mel_dir="./mel_cache", augment=False):
        self.df = dataframe
        self.mel_dir = mel_dir
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        file_path = row["file"]
        label = row["label"]

        # Match the same naming rule
        filename = file_path.replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_").replace(".wav", ".npy")
        mel_path = os.path.join(self.mel_dir, filename)

        mel_db = np.load(mel_path)
        mel_db = torch.tensor(mel_db).unsqueeze(0).float()

        # Augmentation for only training
        if self.augment:
            mel_db = spec_augment(mel_db)

        label = torch.tensor(label).long()

        return mel_db, label

Build Model

class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=500):
        super().__init__()

        # Derived from "Attention is all you need"
        pe = torch.zeros(max_len, d_model)
        pos = torch.arange(0, max_len).unsqueeze(1)
        div = torch.exp(torch.arange(0, d_model, 2) * (-np.log(10000.0) / d_model))

        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(pos * div)
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(pos * div)

        self.pe = pe.unsqueeze(0)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, :x.size(1)].to(x.device)
class CNN_Transformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super(CNN_Transformer, self).__init__()

        # Extract CNN features
        self.conv_block = nn.Sequential(

            # Block 1
            nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1)),  # reduce freq only, retain temporal precision

            # Block 2
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1)),  # reduce freq only, retain temporal precision

            # Block 3
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.MaxPool2d((2, 1)),  # reduce freq only, retain temporal precision

            # Block 4
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
        )

        self.lstm_input_size = 256 * 16  # Output after cnn section
        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(self.lstm_input_size, 256)  # Project to transformer dimension

        # Transformer for temporal patterns
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=256,
            nhead=4,
            dim_feedforward=256,
            dropout=0.2,
            batch_first=True,
            norm_first=True
        )

        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            encoder_layer,
            num_layers=2
        )

        self.pos_enc = PositionalEncoding(256)  # Positional encoding

        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)  # LayerNormalization

        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)  # Dropout

        self.fc = nn.Linear(256, num_classes)

        # Transformer
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(128, 1)
        )

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.conv_block(x)

        # Rearrange cnn output for time series
        x = x.permute(0, 3, 1, 2)  # (B, T, C, F)
        B, T, C, Freq = x.shape
        x = x.reshape(B, T, C * Freq)

        # For transformer
        x = self.input_proj(x)  # Down to input dimension
        x = self.pos_enc(x)
        ts_out = self.transformer(x)
        ts_out = self.norm(ts_out)  # LayerNormalization

        # Add attention
        attn_weights = torch.softmax(self.attention(ts_out), dim=1)
        out = torch.sum(attn_weights * ts_out, dim=1)

        out = self.dropout(out)
        out = self.fc(out)
        return out

Training + Validation Loop

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

model = CNN_Transformer(num_classes=6).to(device)

criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)  # Loss function

optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(
    model.parameters(),
    lr = 3e-4,
    weight_decay=1e-4
)

# Employ scheduler for better generalization
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    optimizer,
    mode='min',
    patience=2,
    factor=0.3
)

num_epochs = 200
patience = 5  # early stopping patience
c:\Users\Thunderup\anaconda3\envs\audio_dl\lib\site-packages\torch\nn\modules\transformer.py:282: UserWarning: enable_nested_tensor is True, but self.use_nested_tensor is False because encoder_layer.norm_first was True
  warnings.warn(f"enable_nested_tensor is True, but self.use_nested_tensor is False because {why_not_sparsity_fast_path}")
best_val_loss = float("inf")
patience_counter = 0

train_losses = []
val_losses = []
train_accs = []
val_accs = []

for epoch in range(num_epochs):

    # -----------
    # Training
    # -----------
    model.train()
    running_loss = 0
    correct = 0
    total = 0

    for x, y in train_loader:
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)

        optimizer.zero_grad()

        outputs = model(x)
        loss = criterion(outputs, y)

        loss.backward()

        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)  # Gradient clipping
        
        optimizer.step()

        running_loss += loss.item() * x.size(0)

        _, predicted = torch.max(outputs, 1)

        correct += (predicted == y).sum().item()
        total += y.size(0)

    # Record loss and accuracy
    train_loss = running_loss / total
    train_acc = correct / total

    train_losses.append(train_loss)
    train_accs.append(train_acc)

    # -----------
    # Validation
    # -----------
    model.eval()
    val_running_loss = 0
    val_correct = 0
    val_total = 0

    with torch.no_grad():
        for x, y in val_loader:
            x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)

            outputs = model(x)
            loss = criterion(outputs, y)

            val_running_loss += loss.item() * x.size(0)

            _, predicted = torch.max(outputs, 1)
            
            val_correct += (predicted == y).sum().item()
            val_total += y.size(0)

    # Record loss and accuracy
    val_loss = val_running_loss / val_total
    val_acc = val_correct / val_total

    val_losses.append(val_loss)
    val_accs.append(val_acc)

    scheduler.step(val_loss)  # Learning rate scheduler

    print(f"Epoch [{epoch+1}/{num_epochs}]")
    print(f"Train Loss: {train_loss:.4f} | Train Acc: {train_acc:.4f}")
    print(f" Val  Loss: {val_loss:.4f} |  Val  Acc: {val_acc:.4f}")
    print("-" * 50)

    # -----------
    # Early Stopping
    # -----------
    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        patience_counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1

    if patience_counter >= patience:
        print("Early stopping triggered.")
        break

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

min_val_loss_epoch = val_losses.index(min(val_losses)) + 1

# Truncate the data up to the minimum validation loss epoch
epochs_truncated = range(1, min_val_loss_epoch + 1)
train_losses_truncated = train_losses[:min_val_loss_epoch]
val_losses_truncated = val_losses[:min_val_loss_epoch]

plt.figure()
plt.plot(epochs_truncated, train_losses_truncated, label="Train Loss")
plt.plot(epochs_truncated, val_losses_truncated, label="Validation Loss")
plt.xlabel("Epoch")
plt.ylabel("Loss")
plt.title("Training vs Validation Loss")
plt.legend()
plt.show()

Testing

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

test_correct = 0
test_total = 0

with torch.no_grad():
    for x, y in test_loader:
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)

        outputs = model(x)

        _, predicted = torch.max(outputs, 1)

        test_correct += (predicted == y).sum().item()
        test_total += y.size(0)

test_acc = test_correct / test_total
print(f"Test Accuracy: {test_acc:.4f}")
Test Accuracy: 0.7004

    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
    sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Greens",
                xticklabels=emotion_names,
                yticklabels=emotion_names)

    plt.title(f"Confusion Matrix - {dataset_type}")
    plt.xlabel("Predicted")
    plt.ylabel("True")
    plt.show()

    print(f"\n===== {dataset_type} Report =====")
    print(classification_report(y_true, y_pred))
